## Problem

What problem would this feature solve? Is it related to a limitation you
hit (e.g. model size, timeout, plan memory limits)?

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered, and why they were
not pursued.

## Additional context

Anything else that might help — links, references, or examples. If this
touches cost-relevant behavior (deploying, bucket creation, registry
pushes), note that explicitly so reviewers can weigh the cost-safety
implications described in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
